in_marathi.name: Harinarayani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Hari's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harinarayani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harinarayani is a Sanskrit name derived from the words Harini (Goddess Hari's grace) and Rayani (beauty or radiance). It is believed that the name signifies the divine grace and beauty bestowed upon the bearer by Lord Hari, a deity revered in Hinduism.
